name: Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube) lead
normative-structure: The Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube) lead answers for the demand Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube) takes from the settlement signal board: it assesses each taken demand in the terms of the faces Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube) serves, turns what is Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube)'s work into work its own offices do, posts what another micro-enterprise does back on the board, and gives back what is not Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube)'s work with its reasons. It staffs nothing outside Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube), does not hand a signal to a chosen enterprise, and does not accept its own results.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi sanquan: a micro-enterprise's decision right (what it takes) and personnel right (who does it) are its own; its lead staffs only from its own offices
